contract: Sum includes all samples, including the last.
With appends to a new list. A caller can keep using the original backing array.
check: all:=[]int{2,4,6}; out:=With(all[:2],7); if all[2]!=6 || out[2]!=7 {t.Errorf("source=%v result=%v",all,out)}

label.expected_impact: append가 공유 배열의 다음 원소를 덮어쓴다.
label.corrected_counterevidence: 새 배열을 만든 뒤 원소를 복사한다.

contract: A successful Open returns an open reader. The caller owns Close.
check: r,w:=io.Pipe(); defer w.Close(); reader,err:=Open(r); if err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}; defer reader.Close(); go w.Write([]byte{'a'}); b:=make([]byte,1); n,err:=reader.Read(b); if n!=1 || err!=nil {t.Errorf("read=%d %v",n,err)}

label.expected_impact: 반환 전에 reader가 닫혀 호출자가 읽을 수 없다.
